executiveSummary.description: Resortslite-Con2 (Con2CMP) containerization readiness: all 11 blockers fixed, build green on Java 8. Fixed hardcoded absolute file paths (cz-java-0057) by replacing with environment variables, hardcoded port (cz-java-0061) with env var, hardcoded IP address (cz-java-0062) with env var, server-side in-memory sessions (cz-java-0063, cz-java-0069) by adding Spring Session with Redis, and in-memory local cache (cz-java-0070) by replacing with Redis-backed Spring Cache. Added spring-boot-starter-actuator for /actuator/health health check endpoint. Container files written: Dockerfile (multi-stage, amazoncorretto:8 runtime), .dockerignore, docker-compose.yml, kubernetes manifests (namespace, deployment, service, ingress), build-push scripts (sh/bat), deploy-image scripts (sh/bat), and DEPLOYMENT.md. The application builds and verifies successfully on Java 8. Redis is configured via environment variables and provided separately; H2 in-memory database is retained as part of the project. Before deploying to AWS EKS, provision an ElastiCache for Redis and set REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT, and REDIS_PASSWORD secrets.

Multi-stage build: maven:3.9.4-eclipse-temurin-8 build stage compiles with mvn clean package, amazoncorretto:8 runtime stage runs app.jar on port 8080 with JAVA_OPTS -Xmx512m -Xms256m -XX:+UseContainerSupport -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0, non-root user, health endpoint /actuator/health
Excludes target/, .git/, *.md, mvnw, mvnw.cmd, .mvn/, gradlew, gradlew.bat, gradle/wrapper/, .idea/, .vscode/, *.iml, .DS_Store

Single service resortslite with image resortslite:latest, port 8080, environment variables from shell (REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT, REPORT_PATH, BACKUP_PATH, SERVER_PORT, PAYMENT_API_URL, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD), volumes for config and data
Namespace resortslite with label name: resortslite

Deployment resortslite with 2 replicas, image {{IMAGE_URI}}, containerPort 8080, env from secrets (REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT, REDIS_PASSWORD, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD) and env vars (REPORT_PATH, BACKUP_PATH, SERVER_PORT, PAYMENT_API_URL), resources (250m/512Mi requests, 500m/1Gi limits), liveness/readiness probes on /actuator/health
ClusterIP service resortslite-service, port 80 to containerPort 8080, selector app: resortslite
ALB ingress resortslite-ingress with kubernetes.io/ingress.class: alb and alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internet-facing, host resortslite.example.com, path / to resortslite-service:80
Builds Docker image with docker build -f Dockerfile -t <registry>/<repo>:<tag> ., supports ECR and Docker Hub, creates ECR repo if missing, logs in and pushes
Windows batch equivalent of build-push.sh with ECR login and repository creation

Deploys to AWS EKS: asks for AWS region, EKS cluster name, image URI, and env vars; creates Kubernetes Secret for credentials; replaces {{PLACEHOLDER}} values in deployment.yaml; applies namespace, deployment, service, ingress; waits for rollout
Windows batch equivalent of deploy-image.sh with PowerShell-based placeholder replacement

Documents prerequisites, local setup with Docker Compose, build and push, AWS EKS deployment, Kubernetes manifests, health checks, scaling, troubleshooting, configuration management, and security considerations
